messages:
maria (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we're opening a temporary 'staging' bucket for late performance review submissions and manager approvals. This is only for edge cases (illness, LOA, timezone snafus). Please read steps and RT if you own approvals.

sam (HRBP): Clarify: what qualifies as 'late' for this bucket? missed deadline by <48h? managers who forgot to sign?

maria (People Ops): Good Q. Policy: main deadline was Mon 11:59pm PT. Staging covers submissions received before EOD Fri (this week). Managers must still complete their approval checkbox in the shared sheet within 48h of submission.

ajay (Eng Manager): I have 2 reports who submitted their self-forms late. Do I need to re-upload anything or just mark approval in the sheet?

maria (People Ops): Just mark the Approvals column in the master sheet and add the timestamp in the "staging notes" column. If you need the form re-uploaded (e.g., wrong attachments) ping @lisa and we'll re-ingest. Link to intake form: https://forms.redwood.com/review-intake

lisa (People Ops): I'll be handling the import queue. After managers mark approvals I'll run a batch import at 12:30pm. If you want to pre-check your team's rows, go here: https://sheets.redwood.com/ops-reviews (filter: staging).

noah (Recruiting Ops): FYI recruiting needs headcount lock by Mon 9am — if any approvals impact offers, flag me in the sheet so I can pause workflows.

forms-bot: Form received: ajay@redwood — 2 submissions. (auto)

maria (People Ops): Import command (for transparency) — this is the one lisa will run:
```
curl -o reviews.csv "https://console.redwood/reviews/export?cycle=Q1-2026&bucket=staging"
# then import via admin tool: ./hris-import --file reviews.csv --mode append
```

lisa (People Ops): I'll validate duplicates before import and post a short summary when done. Expect a 1–2 hour window for processing.

ajay (Eng Manager): Thanks — I'll go mark approvals now and add short reasons for each late submit (health + timezone).

sam (HRBP): One ask: if managers miss the 48h approval window, what happens? escalate to People Ops?

maria (People Ops): Yes — if not approved in 48h we escalate to the manager's manager and cc HRBP. We'll keep that as a last resort.

noah (Recruiting Ops): Noted. @maria please ping if any case affects offers or headcount so we can freeze changes.

maria (People Ops): Final note: if you need a 1:1 walkthrough for the staging flow, book a 15-min slot here: https://calendly.redwood.com/people-ops/15 — otherwise we'll post an import complete message in this thread with the summary. :white_check_mark:
